::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** [11 July 1892]  
**Manuscript:** MS Charlotte Mitchell/33[^1]
:::

This life is not the Temple but the Gate
Where men secure of entrance watch and wait

		[Aubrey de Vere](people/person_2259.qmd)

Dear [Mrs Trebeck](people/person_1416.qmd)

I am afraid this is too late but I cannot help sending it

yours sincerely

C M Yonge

They are the end of his sonnet in answer to ‘A life worth living[‘]

---

[^1]: With envelope addressed to Mrs Trebeck/ Southwell/ Notts and postmarked Winchester 11 July 1892. Mary Trebeck edited *The Blue Birthday Book:  Proverbs, Maxims and Quotations for Every Day of the Year*  (London: Gardner, Darton 1898).
